entries.name: Adjudication process
entries.definition: The formal process of reviewing a claim, application or dispute and deciding the outcome under set rules.

entries.name: Administering blood tests
entries.definition: Performing blood tests on patients, typically drawing a sample and preparing it for laboratory analysis.

entries.name: Administrative law
entries.definition: The body of law governing how government agencies make rules and decisions and how those actions can be challenged.

entries.name: Adobe Analytics
entries.definition: Adobe's product for measuring and analysing customer behaviour on websites and apps.

entries.name: Adobe ColdFusion
entries.definition: A commercial web application server and development platform, now from Adobe, that runs applications written in CFML.

entries.name: Adobe Experience Platform Launch
entries.definition: Adobe's tag management system for deploying and managing marketing and analytics tags on websites and apps.

entries.name: Adobe Fonts
entries.definition: Adobe's subscription font service, formerly called Typekit, which supplies fonts for websites and desktop applications.

entries.name: Adobe PhotoDeluxe
entries.definition: A discontinued consumer photo-editing program from Adobe, aimed at home users rather than professionals.

entries.name: Adobe Substance 3D Designer
entries.definition: Adobe software for creating procedural materials and textures for 3D graphics by connecting nodes in a graph.

entries.name: Adobe Substance 3D Painter
entries.definition: Adobe software for painting textures and materials directly onto 3D models.

entries.name: Advanced Automatic Collision Notification
entries.definition: Vehicle telematics that automatically alert emergency services after a crash and send data about how severe it was.

entries.name: Advertising design
entries.definition: Creating the visual look of advertisements, such as layouts, imagery and typography.

entries.name: Aerospike Database
entries.definition: A distributed NoSQL database built for fast, large-scale key-value access.

entries.name: AG Grid
entries.definition: A JavaScript data-grid component for web applications that displays, sorts, filters and edits large tables of data.

entries.name: Agent evaluation
entries.definition: Testing agent outcomes, traces and boundary conditions.

entries.name: Agile software development
entries.definition: An approach to building software in short iterative cycles with frequent feedback and close collaboration.

entries.name: Agricultural machinery
entries.definition: Machines used in farming, such as tractors, combine harvesters, ploughs and seed drills.

entries.name: AI copywriting
entries.definition: Writing marketing and advertising copy with the help of generative AI tools.

entries.name: Air Travel Organisers' Licensing
entries.definition: A UK Civil Aviation Authority scheme that requires travel businesses selling flight-inclusive packages to hold a licence that protects customers' money.

entries.name: Airworthiness engineering
entries.definition: Engineering that demonstrates and maintains that an aircraft meets the requirements for safe flight.

entries.name: Ajax
entries.definition: Asynchronous client/server web interaction techniques.

entries.name: ÄKTA
entries.definition: A family of liquid chromatography systems, now sold by Cytiva, used mainly to purify proteins and other biomolecules.

entries.name: Aldus PhotoStyler
entries.definition: A discontinued Windows image-editing program first released by Aldus.

entries.name: Alexa Internet
entries.definition: Amazon's web-traffic analytics and site-ranking service, which was shut down in 2022.
variants: Alexa - Actionable Analytics For The Web

entries.name: Algorithm analysis
entries.definition: Reasoning about correctness, time and space complexity.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud
entries.definition: The cloud-computing services of Alibaba Group.

entries.name: AlienVault
entries.definition: Security-monitoring software, notably the USM and OSSIM products, from the company later acquired by AT&T.

entries.name: All-terrain vehicle
entries.definition: A motorised off-road vehicle with low-pressure tyres, designed for rough terrain.

entries.name: Allergen labelling
entries.definition: Declaring the allergens in food products on packaging or menus as the law requires.

entries.name: AllJoyn
entries.definition: An open-source software framework for discovering and communicating between nearby connected devices, originally from Qualcomm.

entries.name: AlloyUI
entries.definition: A JavaScript user-interface framework from Liferay, built on YUI and Bootstrap.

entries.name: Allyship
entries.definition: Actively supporting the inclusion and rights of groups one does not belong to, for example by speaking up and sharing opportunities.

entries.name: Alooma
entries.definition: A cloud service for building data pipelines that move data from many sources into data warehouses, acquired by Google in 2019.

entries.name: Alternative dispute resolution
entries.definition: Ways of settling disputes without a court trial, such as mediation and arbitration.

entries.name: Alternative Transients Program
entries.definition: Simulation software for electromagnetic transients in electrical power systems, derived from the EMTP.

entries.name: Aluminium smelting
entries.definition: The industrial process of making aluminium metal from alumina by electrolysis in a molten bath.

entries.name: Amazon AppStream 2.0
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services service that streams desktop applications from AWS to a user's web browser.

entries.name: Amazon CloudWatch
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services service that collects metrics, logs and events from AWS resources and applications for monitoring, alarms and troubleshooting.

entries.name: Amazon EMR
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services service for running big-data frameworks such as Apache Spark and Hadoop on managed clusters.

entries.name: Amazon Fire tablet
entries.definition: Amazon's line of Android-based tablets, sold as the Kindle Fire when first launched in 2011.
